messages.subject: Trouble with isolate()
parts:
The general structure of my server.R is like this:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  region <- reactive({
    input$goButton
    isolate({
      data <- fetch.data(input$feature1, input$feature2)
      process(data)
    })
  })
  processed.data <- reactive({
    do.some.stuff(region())
  })
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    do.plot(processed.data(), input$option1, input$option2)
  })
})

My app has multiple inputs but the region() calculation is expensive and I don't want to trigger invalidations of the entire dependency graph while someone is in the middle of filling in its inputs.  So I've added an actionButton to trigger reevaluation of region().  But I want the plot generation to react immediately to other inputs (option1, option2).  The button is working (it does trigger reevaluation of region) but my isolate() seems to be ignored -- region() is also getting triggered whenever input$feature1 or input$feature2 is modified?

I'm using shiny 0.9.1 on R-2.15.3

-- Dave

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with isolate()
parts:
Hmmm, that shouldn't be. Can you try the reactive graph visualizer?

1) Restart R session
2) Run "option(shiny.reactlog=TRUE)"
3) Launch your app
4) Modify input$feature1
5) Hit Ctrl-F3 (or Cmd-F3 on Mac)

If that doesn't help, let us know.

messages.subject: Re: Trouble with isolate()
parts:
Wow, that's slick.

The log did confirm what I observed: when I modified input$feature1, that invalidated region() and everything that depends on it.

But I did solve my problem.  For some reason I can't explain, I had done:

isolate
({...})

instead of:

isolate({...})

and that was my problem.

-- Dave
